sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: getting your Nevada license (eligibility, documents, residency and testing)
Knowledge facts: part C holds 42 fact blocks (sec01-F01 onward) from physical pages 6 to 12; part C2 holds 17 confusable and continuation blocks (sec01-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A names the issuer (physical page 3), the DMV 700 March 2024 edition (physical page 1) and the test format from the Testing page (physical page 12); question count, passing standard and time limit are not printed and stay unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NV-LICA-A-COUNT — knowledge-test question count not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-LICA-A-PASS — passing score or percentage not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-LICA-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-LICA-A-FRESH — confirm the March 2024 edition is still current (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-LICA-D-COLUMNS — which residency documents must be dated within sixty days versus last issued (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- NV-LICA-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NV-LICA-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: test fees, immigration-document rules, accepted document lists, the DMV phone numbers and the website (for example sec01-F38, sec01-F18) can change and must be refreshed from the Nevada DMV website.

corpus_stability.reason: The Nevada Driver's Handbook carries one edition line on its cover (DMV 700 March 2024) and one copyright year on its title page, with a short key-changes list; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year. The edition is about two and a half years old at intake, so currency is held as freshness debt in part A.
